t2i_prompt: Flat vector closing section on warm limestone paper with a thin navy border and a small title block bottom-right. Bold navy headline top-left. Two tall bordered columns: the left lists numbered inputs with mono numerals and a vertical gutter rule; the right lists outputs, each with a small dog-eared document thumbnail holding a miniature chart, flow diagram or table. Between them a large outlined arrow carries a small steel-blue tag. One filled steel-blue button centred below. <CONTENT>. Hairline strokes, no shadows, lots of air.
signature_idea: The enquiry as a fair trade: four inputs in, four engineering documents back, with the turnaround on the arrow.
strengths: makes the ask concrete and low-risk
brand_fit_why: Limestone, navy, one steel-blue accent and square frames fit; heavy headline and clunky arrow lose some precision.
